The `_ordered` function sorts by absolute value (`key=abs`) instead of sorting values in ascending order. That's the bug — all functions that rely on `_ordered` will produce wrong results when negative numbers are involved.

All 6 tests pass now. The defect was in the `_ordered` helper function, which sorted by absolute value (`key=abs`) instead of sorting numerically. This caused `median`, `quartiles`, and any other function relying on it to produce incorrect results when negative numbers were present.
